package.name: rebot_planner
package.description: Pinocchio-based IK/planning for the reBot B601-DM, replacing MoveIt: step-clamped joint-limit-projected DLS IK and Cartesian-linear waypoint planning (proven in the Isaac Sim grasping track), self- and world-box collision REJECTION (no re-routing until cuMotion), and a MoveToPose action node executing through /rebot_controller/follow_joint_trajectory. Pure-Python cores under rebot_planner/core are rclpy-free and unit-tested without ROS.
